about.title: About Nest by Ammakkili
about.p1: Nest by Ammakkili is an online nightwear label founded on a simple philosophy: sleepwear should feel as gentle as a lullaby and withstand the warmth of everyday tropical living.
about.p2: We specialize in women's nighties tailored from hand-inspected pure cotton, breathable prints, and soothing satins.
about.p3: Every single design is showcased in high-definition video on our YouTube channel, letting you inspect the neckline, seams, texture, and fall before making a decision.

contact.ytNote: You can also watch our channel on {link}.

pricing.title: Pricing & Payment Terms
pricing.lead: Transparent, honest pricing in Indian Rupees with no hidden fees.
pricing.currencyText: All product prices displayed on our store are in Indian Rupees (₹ INR) and are inclusive of applicable Goods and Services Tax (GST). What you see on the product card is the exact item price.
pricing.shippingText: A transparent flat shipping fee of ₹60 is applied per order at checkout regardless of order size or weight across India.
pricing.prepaidText: We operate exclusively on a prepaid basis via Razorpay. We accept UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM), all major Credit/Debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, RuPay), and Indian Net Banking. Cash on Delivery (COD) is strictly not supported.
pricing.changesText: Prices are fixed and verified at checkout. In the rare event of a system pricing discrepancy, we reserve the right to cancel the order and provide an immediate full refund.

shipping.title: Shipping & Delivery Policy
shipping.lead: Reliable pan-India delivery with tracked couriers and flat fulfillment fees.
shipping.rateText: We charge a single flat shipping fee of ₹60 per order across all serviceable postal PIN codes in India. There are no surprise weight or volume surcharges.
shipping.timelineText: Orders are carefully inspected, packed, and handed over to our delivery partners within 1 to 2 business days of order confirmation. Estimated transit time is 3 to 7 business days depending on destination location.
shipping.trackingText: Once your package is dispatched, you will receive a tracking link via SMS, Email, and WhatsApp. You can also monitor delivery status anytime on our Track Order page.
shipping.addressText: Please verify your full address, landmarks, and 6-digit PIN code carefully during checkout. Parcels cannot be rerouted or modified once handed over to the courier partner.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.lead: Please read these terms and conditions carefully before placing your order.
terms.agreementText: By accessing our website and placing an order with Nest by Ammakkili, you agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions, our Privacy Policy, and our Refund Policy.
terms.ordersText: All orders are subject to stock availability and validation of payment. When you place an order, stock is temporarily reserved. If an item becomes unavailable before dispatch, we will notify you and issue an automatic full refund.
terms.prepaidText: All purchases must be prepaid online. Payments are processed securely via Razorpay. Orders without successful payment verification will remain in pending payment status and automatically cancel upon hold expiration.
terms.useText: We take great care in showcasing our products accurately through photos and YouTube videos. However, minor variations in fabric texture or color tone may occur due to screen settings or lighting conditions.
terms.liabilityText: Nest by Ammakkili shall not be liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages resulting from courier delays or temporary platform unavailability.
terms.jurisdictionText: These Terms shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of India. Any disputes arising out of or related to these terms shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the competent courts in Thrissur, Kerala, India.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.lead: How we handle, safeguard, and respect your personal information.
privacy.collectionText: We collect information necessary to fulfill your purchases: your name, contact phone number, email address, delivery shipping address, order history, and Google profile details if you sign in with Google.
privacy.purposeText: Your data is used solely to process transactions, dispatch packages with courier partners, send delivery status updates, respond to WhatsApp customer support queries, and comply with statutory legal and accounting obligations.
privacy.sharingText: We never sell, rent, or trade your personal data. We share only necessary details with trusted service providers: Razorpay (payment processing), authorized courier delivery partners (order shipping), and Cloudinary (high-speed media delivery CDN).
privacy.retentionText: Order and invoice records are retained for statutory tax and legal compliance (typically up to 8 years under Indian commercial tax regulations). Abandoned unpaid orders are automatically purged. Customer account records remain active until you request deletion.
privacy.cookiesText: We use only essential, secure session cookies strictly required for login authentication, shopping cart persistence, and CSRF protection. We do not use third-party marketing trackers, behavioral profiling, or advertising pixels.
privacy.rightsText: You have the right to request a copy of your personal data or request permanent deletion of your customer account. To do so, please message us on WhatsApp or email our support desk. Requests are acknowledged within 48 hours.

refundPolicy.title: Refund & Cancellation Policy
refundPolicy.lead: Clear, honest policy regarding order cancellations, refunds, and intimate wear hygiene.
refundPolicy.noReturnsTitle: 1. No Returns, Exchanges, or Size Changes
refundPolicy.noReturnsText: Because nightwear is personal intimate apparel, and every piece undergoes individual hand-inspection prior to dispatch, we strictly do not accept returns, replacements, or size exchanges once an order has been shipped. Please measure your bust accurately with our Size Guide before placing an order.
refundPolicy.cancellationText: Orders can only be cancelled before they have been handed over to the courier partner for dispatch. To request a cancellation, message our WhatsApp support immediately with your order ID.
refundPolicy.soldOutText: In the rare event that an item is out of stock after payment is captured, our system automatically initiates a 100% full refund within 7 business days.
refundPolicy.refundMethodText: All approved refunds are credited back directly to the original payment source (UPI account, credit/debit card, or bank account) used during checkout via our payment partner Razorpay.
refundPolicy.supportText: For any questions regarding cancellations or refunds, message our team on WhatsApp with your Order ID for prompt assistance.

grievance.title: Grievance Redressal Mechanism
grievance.lead: Consumer protection and grievance handling pursuant to the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020.
grievance.officerText: In accordance with the Information Technology Act, 2000 and the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020, the contact details of our Grievance Officer are published below:
grievance.processText: Any consumer complaint or grievance will be acknowledged within 48 hours of receipt. Our team will investigate and resolve the issue within 30 days (1 month) from the date of receipt.
grievance.filingText: Please email or write to the Grievance Officer detailing your order number, date of purchase, registered phone number, and nature of the concern.

policies.title: Shop policies
policies.paymentText: All orders must be prepaid online via our secure payment gateway. Cash on Delivery (COD) is strictly not supported.
policies.returnsText: Because nightwear is personal intimate clothing, and each piece is quality inspected prior to dispatch, we do not accept any returns, replacements, or size exchanges once an order is confirmed.
policies.shippingText: We ship orders across India with trusted courier partners at a flat shipping fee of ₹60 per order. Orders are typically packed and dispatched within 1–2 business days.
policies.privacyText: We collect customer names, phone numbers, and delivery addresses strictly to process, dispatch, and communicate regarding orders.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: Clear answers to help you order with complete confidence.
faq.q1: Can I return or exchange a nighty?
faq.a1: No. To maintain hygiene and quality, we operate a strict no-return and no-exchange policy. Please consult our bust measurement guide prior to ordering.
faq.a2: No. All orders are strictly prepaid via UPI, debit/credit cards, or netbanking.
faq.a3: No. We handle customer support exclusively via WhatsApp messages. We do not operate a telephone call center.
faq.q4: How do I choose the correct size?
faq.a4: Measure around the fullest part of your bust in inches with a measuring tape. Match it to our Size Guide table or use the interactive Bust Calculator.
faq.q5: How do I know my order is confirmed?
faq.a5: Once payment succeeds, you will see the confirmation screen with an order ID. You can click 'Send order details on WhatsApp' to connect with us directly.
